== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker) (Dark) (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker) (Dark)]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100674 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 100674], [https://theswca.com/imgup/100674-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(90, 50, 680, 930)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>b8ac42d303524e17dfbaa58c6f09c580be9ec0011210614362766358bb399030</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
